highlights: In a world of AI agents, that's speed and token spend.
A well-designed CLI is muscle memory for an agent: no hunting through docs, no wrong turns, no wasted tokens.
We built the Printing Press to print the best CLIs in the world for agents.
It fuses all of that and prints a token-efficient Go CLI plus a Claude Code skill plus an MCP server for any API or any website.
flight-goat (Kayak nonstop search plus sniffed Google Flights).

The skills (/printing-press ) are the primary interface; they drive the binary behind the scenes.
